summary.en: Existing releases: A second-order reversible symplectic method using half kick, drift and half kick for position-dependent forces. Released unit-mass harmonic/quartic oscillators illustrate why energy error and geometric structure preservation are different properties. Additional fixed examples: Unsoftened Kepler two-body time error, Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Warm PIC linear Landau damping, Warm PIC two-stream initial growth. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
units: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.

limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: The original Hamiltonian is not exactly preserved at each step. A symplectic map can still be unstable at large steps; for the ω=1 harmonic oscillator, |h|<2 is the interior stability interval. Velocity-dependent forces, friction/thermostats, constraints, generic variable steps and nonseparable Hamiltonians require different treatment. This function is not a general molecular-dynamics solver. Additional fixed examples: One orbit at fixed eccentricity only; softened binaries and long-time behavior are outside this exact reference. Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim. Additional fixed examples: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Additional fixed examples: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration. The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories.

algorithm.ja: 独立側はPythonスカラー配置、明示的な複素DFT和、独自の補間ループを所有します。主側のFFT・配置・補間を呼びません。数学上のCIC、Nyquist規約、velocity-Verlet法、初期配列は共通です。
algorithm.en: The independent path owns scalar deposition, explicit complex DFT sums and scalar gathering; it imports no primary spatial routines. Mathematical CIC, Nyquist convention, velocity-Verlet and initial arrays are intentionally shared.

validation.ja: 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。
validation.en: 19pytest and58/58fixed gates passed. Compare six pairs=twelve self-consistent trajectories at all13states; maximum differences:x8.88e-16,v3.33e-16,E8.33e-16,rho2.89e-15. Shared pytest+main.392s. Initial small pytest retained17/18with a periodic-index failure; integer wrapping was corrected before the first fixed main batch.

limits.ja: 離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limits.en: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit.

title.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み

summary.ja: e=0.1/0.7の16固定軌道で、保存量と同時刻の位相誤差、実際の近日点時刻と逆積分を比較します。
summary.en: Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal.

assumptions.ja: a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。
assumptions.en: a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心力KDK Verlet。固定・保存刻み再生・再生成刻みを区別し、cubic Hermite軌道の正の動径速度での交差をbrentqで局在化。
algorithm.en: Original central-force KDK Verlet. Fixed, replayed and regenerated schedules are distinct. Positive radial crossings of cubic Hermite trajectories are localized by brentq.

validation.ja: 独立のKepler方程式brentq／二分法解析族、92主判定。全状態誤差とエネルギー・角運動量、8回以上の近日点、有限窓の順序と反転誤差を検査。
validation.en: An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects.

limits.ja: 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。
limits.en: Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.

summary.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.

assumptions.ja: α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。
assumptions.en: alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi.

algorithm.ja: 全ポテンシャルVerletと、B半kick・A厳密flow・B半kickのStrang impulse。Aには高速調和振動子と低速自由流、Bには低速位置項と結合を含めます。
algorithm.en: Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.

validation.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。
validation.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.

limits.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
limits.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

summary.en: Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。

BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

algorithm.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
algorithm.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

validation.ja: 解析勾配、4096/8192段の固定RK4感度、拡張エネルギーとOU条件付き分散を照合します。
validation.en: Check energy gradients, fixed4096/8192 RK4 sensitivity, extended energy, OU heat bookkeeping and conditional temperature variance.

limits.ja: 短い自作教育模型です。第一原理・長いNVE・一般CPMD・正準平衡・エルゴード性の成功は主張しません。
